title: Aesthetic: Delete profile leaves old name
body:
Not important. I choose a profile and delete it

![Screenshot_20221110_102952.jpg](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/76626474/201053591-84a9b9f5-378d-4f16-89e6-efaf73071f80.jpg)

Once the profile is deleted, the next profile is shown but in the drop down, it is still the name of the deleted profile that is shown.

![Screenshot_20221110_103014.jpg](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/76626474/201054124-58f5c79c-240e-4d5e-90c0-8c68ae089981.jpg)
